text: Assumption: Arithmetic operations and carry logic are implemented on the caller side — is this correct?

assumption: Arithmetic operations and carry logic are implemented on the caller side.
rationale: The specification defines only the two data elements mLSQW and mMSQW, but offers no arithmetic operations of its own.
